biomarkers.name: BRAF V600E
biomarkers.prevalence: Near-universal in classic HCL; absent in HCL variant/SBLPN
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining feature of classic HCL. Vemurafenib active in R/R HCL; combination with rituximab in relapse. Distinguishes classic HCL from HCL variant/splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukaemia with prominent nucleoli

biomarkers.name: Immunophenotype (CD11c+, CD25+, CD103+, CD123+ + B-cell markers)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Classic HCL typically expresses all four markers strongly

biomarkers.name: Annexin A1
biomarkers.prevalence: Positive in classic HCL (highly specific in this differential)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Helps distinguish classic HCL from other B-cell disorders including HCL variant

biomarkers.name: IGHV4-34 usage (HCL variant)
biomarkers.prevalence: Seen in a subset of HCL-like cases, especially IGHV4-34-positive classic HCL and some HCL variant/SBLPN cases
biomarkers.clinical_use: Associated with poorer prognosis and reduced response to purine analogues; not a defining marker of all HCL variant cases; BRAF inhibitors are not effective in BRAF-wild-type disease

biomarkers.name: MAP2K1 mutations (HCL variant)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports alternative MAPK pathway activation in BRAF-wild-type HCL variant/SBLPN

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Medium-sized B cells with cytoplasmic hairy projections, oval-to-reniform nuclei, and pale cytoplasm; marrow infiltration with reticulin fibrosis ('dry tap')
variants: HCL variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukaemia with prominent nucleoli (typically BRAF wild-type; often MAP2K1-mutant; biologically distinct and relatively purine analogue-resistant)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Distinctive monocytopenia is characteristic of classic HCL and contributes to opportunistic infection risk
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Marrow reticulin fibrosis producing 'dry tap' on aspirate; distinctive 'fried egg' appearance on marrow biopsy with clear cytoplasm and well-separated nuclei

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Post-germinal-center/memory B cells with distinctive hairy cell phenotype; BRAF V600E is the defining mutation for classic HCL
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — lymphoid (mature B cells, post-germinal-center/memory B-cell program)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Mature B cells with distinctive hairy cell projections; CD19+, CD20 bright+, CD25+, CD11c+, CD103+, CD123+, annexin A1+, TRAP+; splenic red pulp tropism
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: BRAF V600E is defining for classic HCL; HCL variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukaemia with prominent nucleoli lacks BRAF V600E and often harbors MAP2K1 mutations, representing distinct biology despite overlapping morphology; splenic red pulp tropism is characteristic
